## Summary

**PMULA** (Vector multiply): 32bit color vector multiply and add. (64bit, so 2 32bit pixels).

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `alfa<100% ? a + alpha x b → d`<br>`alfa=100% ? b → d` |
| Syntax | `PMULA <vea>,b,d` |
| Short | 32bit color vector multiply and add. (64bit, so 2 32bit pixels) |
| Description | Fade b-colors by alfa then add a-colors to it. Resulting colors are unsigned saturated bytes. 0%=&lt;alfa&lt;100% ( alfa x b ) + a → d alfa=100%=255 100% b → d (When alfa is 100% (255) there is no addition done.) |
| Condition codes | not affected |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–9 | `1111111` |
| 1 | 8 | A |
| 1 | 7 | B |
| 1 | 6 | D |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | b |
| 2 | 11–8 | d |
| 2 | 7–0 | `00011001` |

- Long: 8bit alpha = 0..100%, 8bit red 0..255, 8bit green 0..255, 8bit blue 0..255

**Operand layout** (one 32-bit pixel; the original names the bytes alfa, red, green, blue)

| Operand | Alfa | Red | Green | Blue | Role |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| vea | Alfa 8bit | Red 8bit | Green 8bit | Blue 8 bit | Src a |
| b |  | Red 8bit | Green 8bit | Blue 8 bit | Src b |
| d (result) | 0 | Red 8bit | Green 8bit | Blue 8 bit | Dest d |

**Example** (one 32-bit pixel; the original names the bytes alfa, red, green, blue)

| Operand | Alfa | Red | Green | Blue | Role |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| vea | $40 | $10 | $62 | $dc | Sprite |
| b |  | $ff | $80 | $b0 | Background |
| d (result) | 0 | $3f+$10=$4f | $20+$62=$82 | $2c+$dc=$ff | Faded background + sprite |

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no PMULA. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- No rules beyond the details above.
